newsitem.title: LATVIA: Volume up on Latvian bourse, Unibanka falls again.
newsitem.headline: Volume up on Latvian bourse, Unibanka falls again.

text.p: Volume climbed slightly at Latvia's bourse on Wednesday and market leader Unibanka's price fell again, the Riga stock exchange said in a statement.
Overall volume was 89,000 lats compared with 75,000 lats on Tuesday.
Unibanka accounted for almost half of the market turnover at 44,000 lats and its price fell by 2.38 percent to 2.05 lats.
